about_the_game:
Football Academy Manager (FAM) is a football management game focused on scouting, player development, and transfers. Attend matches, identify promising talents, analyze their abilities, and decide who to sign into your academy.

Once signed, you can train your players with a targeted focus, track their progress, and eventually place them at clubs — including negotiating bonuses and sell-on clauses.

Each successful transfer increases your prestige, boosting your chances of signing even better talent in the future. At the same time, you develop your own scout profile and invest in improving your academy — from training focus and staff to infrastructure and tools.

Features:

● Visit matches and evaluate talent live

● Sign, train, and develop your own players

● Negotiate transfer deals with clubs

● Upgrade your academy: trainers, tools, development systems

● Level up your personal scout profile through prestige

● Dynamic player growth based on form, morale, and coaching

Turn raw prospects into professional footballers — no coaching license required.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Dual-Core CPU (e.g., Intel i3)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics (Intel HD Graphics)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: Intel i5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated or dedicated GPU
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
